translation.title: Tyrothricin Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used to improve wounds infected with tyrothricin-susceptible bacteria (for example, abrasions) and festering skin infections.
translation.usage: Apply an appropriate amount to the infected area 2 to 3 times a day. A dressing is not needed for minor wounds or infections of mucosal areas, but a dressing is recommended for heavily oozing wounds, and it is recommended to change the dressing every 1 to 2 applications of this medicine.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or on the mucous membrane of the nose. When using it around the eyes, be careful not to let the medicine touch the eyes directly. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if the symptoms do not improve after a week or more of use. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if hypersensitivity reactions occur, such as a burning feeling of the skin.
